release_note.ru: Режим prompt-injection защиты наследуется субагентом: ребёнок работает с той же настройкой Safety, что и запустивший его диалог. Значение разрешается один раз при запуске и замораживается в записи запуска, поэтому фоновый ребёнок не зависит от настроек чужого диалога; продолжение работы (resume) сохраняет режим исходного запуска, а одноразовое разрешение посмотреть один скрытый фрагмент не наследуется. Промпт DevAgent v3.25 описывает правило агенту, версия платформы 2.13.0.
release_note.en: A subagent inherits the prompt-injection protection mode of the dialog that launched it: the child runs with the same Safety setting as its parent. The value is resolved once at launch and frozen in the run record, so a background child does not depend on another dialog setting; a resume keeps the mode of the original run, while the one-step viewing permission granted for a single withheld payload is not inherited. DevAgent prompt v3.25 states the rule for the agent; platform version 2.13.0.

401/403 hints for MCP HTTP (fine-grained github_pat_*); platform version 2.6.0. 1.40.0: the Connectors page - list <-> form model (connectors_view = list | create | edit): the form replaces the list, tiles only open it, Create stores an already-active connection with the typed secrets, Cancel/back write nothing, a failed save keeps the form open; full-page editing; persistent tabs via st.tabs(on_change='rerun', key, default) since without on_change the widget keeps no state; instantiate_preset gained account/secrets/pending; platform version 2.7.0. 1.41.0: hidden MCP presets - an optional hidden flag in the preset format (list_presets drops it, resolve_preset still finds it by id), the github_mcp preset is marked hidden and leaves the tiles while its connections keep the preset edit form; platform version 2.7.1. 1.43.0: DevAgent defaults - DeepSeek deepseek-flash with xhigh for the main model and image analysis, web search at temperature 0.4 with three tool calls and high effort; the Models tab hides the page-fetch selectors while Selenium is on and keeps the stored pair; save confirmations are painted after the page body (ui/app.py); platform version 2.9.1. 1.44.0: multi-agent orchestration (core/orchestration) - run contract, OrchestrationService with the run tree, slot pool and six delegation limits, cascade cancellation, spawn_agent/invoke_assistant wrappers, fan-out in the agent loop, child threads and journals, the Delegation settings tab; platform version 2.10.0. 1.48.0: the prompt-injection protection is inherited by delegated runs (the enable_injection_protection field on SpawnRequest, frozen in the RunRecord and the durable record, resolved as explicit request -> mode of the resumed run -> protected, carried into the child AgentLoopState through the runner, the agent-loop fan-out takes the live parent state, the one-step viewing bypass is not inherited); DevAgent prompt v3.25; platform version 2.13.0.

note.en: Vkusvill MCP preset (http, mcp.vkusvill.ru): public tools without a token, VKUSVILL_TOKEN unlocks personal data; a secret_env_fields token field; an icon for the MCP tab tile.
